definitions.gloss: assassin; person who carries out an assassination
definitions.explanation: A person who kills a prominent figure, especially for political or ideological reasons.

examples.japanese: {暗殺者|あんさつしゃ}が{逮捕|たいほ}された。
{暗殺者|あんさつしゃ}の{正体|しょうたい}はまだ{明|あき}らかになっていない。
examples.english: The identity of the assassin has not yet been revealed.

examples.japanese: {歴史上|れきしじょう}、{多|おお}くの{指導者|しどうしゃ}が{暗殺者|あんさつしゃ}の{手|て}にかかってきた。
examples.english: Throughout history, many leaders have fallen at the hands of assassins.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in news, history, and fiction. The base word {暗殺|あんさつ} means "assassination," and {者|しゃ} is the suffix for "person."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {暗殺者|あんさつしゃ}を{雇|やと}う (to hire an assassin)
- {暗殺者|あんさつしゃ}の{手|て}にかかる (to fall at the hands of an assassin)
- {暗殺者|あんさつしゃ}を{逮捕|たいほ}する (to arrest an assassin)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {刺客|しかく}: assassin — more literary, often used in historical contexts
- {殺|ころ}し{屋|や}: hitman, hired killer — informal, broader meaning
